title: A Data Privacy Protection Method for Industrial Internet of Things Oriented to Federated Learning Architecture

pse.problem: Limited computing power of industrial IoT terminal nodes and data isolation in most industries make it difficult to obtain a new intrusion detection model through single-node training for dynamic network attacks.
pse.solution_function: The method uses federated learning architecture to allow edge nodes to perform distributed model training and intrusion detection, improving the efficiency of updating the industrial IoT's intrusion detection model without compromising data privacy.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of terminal nodes that provide sample data, edge nodes that store behavior data, and a federated learning architecture for distributed training and intrusion detection.
pse.solution_implementation: Edge nodes compare the difference between data in the database and the data used for the last model update. If necessary, they retrain to update their model parameters without sharing sensitive data with other nodes.
pse.effect: The method provides a more complete intrusion detection model that can adapt to ever-changing network attacks, improving the security of the Industrial Internet of Things.
